headline: WSN @ SFG matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 5.68 at SFG 4.65, with a projected total of 10.34. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: WSN moved +0.66 runs while SFG moved +0.17, changing the projected margin by +0.48 runs. The projected total climbed +0.83, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -5.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Andrew Alvarez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jung Hoo Lee, Luis Arraez, Bryce Eldridge, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Buddy Kennedy, Andrés Chaparro because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
